what_works: High contrast black background with white text ensures strong readability.
Vibrant, irregularly shaped colorful elements add visual interest while maintaining a flat design aesthetic.
Consistent 16px radius on all shapes and UI components creates a cohesive visual language.
Subtle grid and perspective lines suggest depth and an interactive, 3D experience.
Prominent blue call‑to‑action button stands out against the dark backdrop, guiding user attention.
